## Purpose
Several hooks under `hooks/task/` and `hooks/write/` carry their own enforcement-level switch — `ContextBudgetMode` in `context_budget_gate.rs` and the `Mode` enum in `delegation_advisory.rs` — independent of the dispatcher's module-level mode. A mode enum exists whenever a gate's behavior (deny vs warn vs silent) must be tunable per-project via an env var without changing the dispatcher contract. The mold captures how these enums are declared, resolved from env, and defaulted so a new gate's mode reads exactly like its siblings.

## Convention
Folder: apps/rt/src/hooks/task/**, apps/rt/src/hooks/write/** · Extension: .rs · Files of this role in this subproject: 7
The two exemplars read (`context_budget_gate.rs`, `delegation_advisory.rs`) both declare the mode as a small `#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)] enum` with 2-3 variants (e.g. `Observe`/`Warn`/`Strict`, or `Off`/`Warn`), private to the module. A dedicated `fn mode() -> ModeEnum` (or `fn context_budget_mode()`) reads `std::env::var("MUSTARD_*_MODE")` (or a gate-specific name like `CONTEXT_BUDGET_MODE`), lowercases it, and matches known strings, falling through to the safe/advisory default on anything unrecognised or absent — never erroring on a bad env value.

## How to apply
A new mode-carrying gate under `hooks/task/` or `hooks/write/` declares its own private mode enum plus a `fn mode()`/`fn <name>_mode()` resolver following this shape; it must not reuse another gate's enum. The resolver function is unit-tested for its default (unset env) case, mirroring `mode_defaults_to_warn_when_unset` / `threshold_defaults_when_unset` in `delegation_advisory.rs`.
